brief:
Five Palestinians, including two children, were killed by Israeli forces in Gaza since dawn, Gaza's health ministry reported. The deaths occurred across multiple locations, with one shooting incident in Beit Lahia in northern Gaza involving a Palestinian shot by Israeli forces.

The toll marks the latest fatalities in the ongoing conflict between Israeli military operations and Palestinian civilians in the enclave.
dek: Five killed in Gaza, including two children, since dawn The number of Palestinians in Gaza killed by the Israeli military since dawn has risen to five, according to Gaza's health ministry. Israeli forces shot a Palestinian in Beit Lahia in northern Gaza.
title: Israeli forces kill five Palestinians in Gaza, including two children
